name: QueryMind text-to-SQL test set
description: 25 questions with ground-truth SQL over the ecommerce (MySQL) and returns_db (PostgreSQL) databases. Questions do not repeat the few-shot library (sqls/few_shot_examples.json) or the examples in the schema files. Dates are fixed so results are reproducible. query_type follows the intent classifier's precedence: TEMPORAL > AGGREGATE > JOIN > SIMPLE. order_matters is true only where the question asks for an order and the ground truth has no ties.

cases.question: List the SKU and name of every discontinued product.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT sku, name FROM products WHERE status = 'discontinued';

cases.question: Which users checked out as guests? Show their user ID and email.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT user_id, email FROM users WHERE status = 'guest';

cases.question: Show the order number and total amount of every cancelled order.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_number, total_amount FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled';

cases.question: How many products does each brand have in the catalog (any status)?
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT brand, COUNT(*) AS products FROM products GROUP BY brand;

cases.question: What is the total gross revenue of all sales?
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(ol.line_total) AS gross_revenue FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('pending', 'cancelled') AND ol.status <> 'cancelled';

cases.question: What are the top 5 SKUs by units sold? Show the SKU and the units.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT ol.sku, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('pending', 'cancelled') AND ol.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY ol.sku ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 5;
cases.notes: 4th and 5th place tie on units, so row order is not compared.

cases.question: On average, how many order lines does a sales order have?
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(line_count) AS avg_lines_per_order FROM (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('pending', 'cancelled') AND ol.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.order_id) t;

cases.question: Show each subcategory with the name of its parent category.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.name AS subcategory, p.name AS parent_category FROM categories c JOIN categories p ON p.category_id = c.parent_id;

cases.question: List the distinct emails of customers who placed at least one order (any status) through the marketplace channel.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT u.email FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.user_id WHERE o.channel = 'marketplace';

cases.question: Show the order number, product name as sold and quantity of every order line with status returned.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.order_number, ol.product_name, ol.quantity FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id WHERE ol.status = 'returned';

cases.question: List the current list price and sale price of every product in the Headphones category, with the product name.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.name, pp.list_price, pp.sale_price FROM products p JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN product_prices pp ON pp.product_id = p.product_id AND pp.effective_to IS NULL WHERE c.name = 'Headphones';

cases.question: How many sales orders were placed in each month of 2025? Show the month as YYYY-MM.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(placed_at, '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE status NOT IN ('pending', 'cancelled') AND placed_at >= '2025-01-01' AND placed_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(placed_at, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month;

cases.question: What was the gross revenue from sales in the first quarter of 2026?
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(ol.line_total) AS gross_revenue FROM order_lines ol JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('pending', 'cancelled') AND ol.status <> 'cancelled' AND o.placed_at >= '2026-01-01' AND o.placed_at < '2026-04-01';

cases.question: List the order numbers of all orders placed in October 2026.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT order_number FROM orders WHERE placed_at >= '2026-10-01' AND placed_at < '2026-11-01';

cases.question: List the RMA numbers of returns whose refund method is store credit.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT rma_number FROM rma.returns WHERE refund_method = 'store_credit';

cases.question: Which returned items were in defective condition? Show the SKU and product name.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT sku, product_name FROM rma.return_lines WHERE item_condition = 'defective';

cases.question: Show the RMA number and reason code of returns whose goods were received but which are not refunded yet (status received).
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT rma_number, reason_code FROM rma.returns WHERE status = 'received';

cases.question: How many returns are there for each reason code, excluding rejected returns?
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT reason_code, count(*) AS returns FROM rma.returns WHERE status <> 'rejected' GROUP BY reason_code;

cases.question: What is the total amount of money refunded to customers so far?
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT sum(refund_amount) AS refunded FROM rma.returns WHERE status IN ('refunded', 'closed') AND refunded_at IS NOT NULL;

cases.question: How many units were returned for each item condition, excluding rejected returns?
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT rl.item_condition, sum(rl.quantity) AS units FROM rma.return_lines rl JOIN rma.returns r ON r.return_id = rl.return_id WHERE r.status <> 'rejected' GROUP BY rl.item_condition;

cases.question: List the RMA number, SKU and returned quantity for every line of returns whose reason is damaged.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT r.rma_number, rl.sku, rl.quantity FROM rma.returns r JOIN rma.return_lines rl ON rl.return_id = r.return_id WHERE r.reason_code = 'damaged';

cases.question: Show the RMA number and returned product names of every return with status closed.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT r.rma_number, rl.product_name FROM rma.returns r JOIN rma.return_lines rl ON rl.return_id = r.return_id WHERE r.status = 'closed';

cases.question: Which returns were requested in September 2026? Show the RMA number and status.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT rma_number, status FROM rma.returns WHERE requested_at >= '2026-09-01' AND requested_at < '2026-10-01';

cases.question: For returns refunded in 2026, what is the average number of days from the return request to the refund?
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT avg(extract(epoch FROM refunded_at - requested_at) / 86400) AS avg_days FROM rma.returns WHERE status IN ('refunded', 'closed') AND refunded_at >= '2026-01-01' AND refunded_at < '2027-01-01';
cases.notes: An answer rounded to one or two decimals (e.g. 8.6 for 8.6477) still matches.

cases.question: How many non-rejected returns were requested in each quarter of 2026? Show the quarter as a number from 1 to 4.
cases.ground_truth_sql: SELECT extract(quarter FROM requested_at)::int AS quarter, count(*) AS returns FROM rma.returns WHERE status <> 'rejected' AND requested_at >= '2026-01-01' AND requested_at < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
